title: Senior FI Specialist
description:
Role Description:

Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG) is a global powerhouse in online travel, connecting millions of people with unforgettable experiences in over 220 countries and territories. With a market value of approximately $120 billion and a diverse portfolio of brands such as Booking.com, KAYAK, Priceline, Agoda.com and OpenTable, we’re committed to making it easier to explore everyone to experience the world.


Booking Holdings Bangalore is a cutting\-edge Center of Excellence in Bangalore, India and a key arm of Booking Holdings Inc. Top talent from diverse backgrounds converge here to develop innovative solutions that drive Booking Holdings' brands and business units forward. We offer a vibrant and inclusive workplace that fosters creativity, growth and opportunities to make a real difference on a global scale.

  

From bustling cities to remote corners, Booking Holdings' travel brands span 220\+ countries. Our FinTech team powers the financial engine behind this global network. We craft bespoke payment solutions, blending security with scalability. These tools empower our partners, fueling their growth and enhancing traveler experiences. By supporting our partners' success, we strengthen the foundation of our diverse travel ecosystem.

  

We are seeking a seasoned **Senior FI Specialist** **(IC Role)** with 15\+ years of hands\-on experience in SAP S/4HANA Finance (FICO) and enterprise architecture. Operating as a lead technical authority and individual contributor, you will drive the architectural blueprint, end\-to\-end solution design, and technical delivery of enterprise\-scale Record\-to\-Report (R2R) platforms.


This role requires deep functional and technical expertise in SAP S/4HANA, high\-volume transactional integrations (specifically with BRIM), and modern enterprise financial platforms. You will serve as the primary bridge between Finance leadership, Product Managers, Technical Architects, and System Integrators (SIs), shaping the future of our financial tech stack, safeguarding North Star Architecture (NSA) principles, and ensuring zero\-defect accounting compliance across complex ERP transformation programs (including RISE with SAP).

**What You’ll Be Doing**
------------------------

#### **1\. Architectural Leadership \& Engineering Excellence**

* **Solution Architecture Ownership:** Own the end\-to\-end architecture and solution design for SAP S/4HANA Finance (R2R) across all project phases (Explore, Realize, Deploy, Hypercare), ensuring strict alignment between core accounting principles, business requirements, and system scalability.
* **Core FICO Domain Expertise:** Drive design authority across core domains:


	+ General Ledger (GL): Universal Journal (ACDOCA), parallel ledgers, document splitting, multi\-currency frameworks, and financial close automation.
	+ Asset Accounting (AA): Asset lifecycle management, multi\-GAAP depreciation areas, and integration workflows.
	+ Subledger Accounting (AP/AR \& FICA): Business Partner and Contract Account master data, posting areas, main/sub configurations, payment processing, and open\-item clearing.
	+ Intercompany Accounting: Cross\-entity netting, intercompany settlement routing, and period\-end elimination matching.
	+ Managerial Accounting (CO): Cost/Profit Center accounting, internal orders, margin analysis, and managerial reporting.
* **ABAP \& Technical Oversight:** Conduct deep\-code reviews, debugging, and root\-cause analysis. Guide engineering teams on SAP programming best practices, performance tuning, and database optimization (ACDOCA/HANA views).
* **WRICEF Governance \& Clean Core:** Review and validate WRICEF (Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, Forms) objects. Drive strict "Clean Core" standardization vs. customization decisions to minimize technical debt and avoid unnecessary custom builds.
* **Design Governance \& Quality Control:** Review and sign off on Solution Design Documents (SDDs), Enterprise Structure Key Design Decisions (KDDs), and L3–L5 process maps. Ensure all designs meet strict audit readiness, SOX controls, and financial compliance standards.

#### **2\. Enterprise Integrations \& Ecosystem Orchestration**

* **BRIM Integration:** Drive deep integration designs between FI and SAP BRIM (Billing and Revenue Innovation Management) to ensure compliant order\-to\-cash, billing ingestion, and revenue accounting (IFRS 15\) flows.
* **Ecosystem Connectivity:** Architect robust integration patterns connecting SAP with third\-party and ecosystem platforms, including BlackLine (Intercompany Hub, SOX Certifications, Multi\-Source Reconciliations), OneStream/FinDB, Snowflake data lakes, and custom middleware (MuleSoft API gateways).
* **Reconciliation Integrity:** Validate end\-to\-end data pipelines (Subledger \-\>GL \-\> Reporting platforms), ensuring complete financial reconciliation, zero data loss, and zero breaks in double\-entry accounting logic.

#### **3\. SAP Transformation \& RISE Implementation**

* **RISE Execution:** Serve as the lead technical authority on large\-scale programs such as RISE with SAP / S/4HANA transformation programs across Explore, Realize, Deploy, and Hypercare phases.
* **System Integrator (SI) Challenge:** Partner closely with System Integrators to validate, guide, and challenge proposed solutions, stopping rigid template\-driven approaches that do not fit the enterprise's long\-term architectural vision.
* **Migration \& Cutover:** Oversee financial data migration strategies, cutover plans, parallel\-run validations, and testing frameworks (SIT/UAT) from a technical finance standpoint.

#### **4\. Strategic Influence \& Stakeholder Management**

* **Cross\-Track Alignment:** Act as an individual contributor thought\-leader and bridge between Finance, Engineering, Product Management, and external partners, translating complex business requirements into elegant system behaviors.
* **Domain Mentorship:** Foster internal engineering/architectural capability by mentoring junior/mid\-level engineers and architects on SAP S/4HANA best practices, integration patterns, and emerging technologies (e.g., AI/automation in month\-end financial closing).

#### **5\. Innovation \& Continuous Improvement**

* **Financial Process Automation \& AI:** Evaluate, architect, and prototype emerging automation technologies, including AI/ML use cases for intelligent anomaly detection, Business Process Automation, Document AI, automated cash application, AI\-assisted month\-end close (MEC) forecasting, and robotic process automation (RPA), to reduce manual finance effort and improve reporting accuracy.
* **Architecture Evolution \& "Clean Core"**: Continually assess technical debt across our SAP and connected ecosystems. Proactively design refactoring plans to decouple legacy custom code, migrating toward SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) services, standard APIs, and "Clean Core" extensibility patterns.
* **Benchmarking \& Tooling Optimization:** Research industry best practices and stay ahead of the curve on vendor roadmaps (SAP S/4HANA releases, RISE updates, BlackLine innovations, BRIM enhancements). Identify opportunities to replace expensive custom builds with native out\-of\-the\-box system capabilities.
* **Engineering Thought Leadership:** Act as a catalyst for continuous improvement within the engineering track by introducing automated testing frameworks for SAP, CI/CD pipeline enhancements for transport manager

**What You’ll Be Bringing**
---------------------------

* **Experience:** 15\+ years of progressive experience in SAP Finance (FI/CO), with at least 7\+ years in solution architecture, lead engineering, or technical authority roles.
* **Role Focus:** Proven track record as a high\-impact Individual Contributor capable of driving architectural consensus without direct line management authority.
* **S/4HANA Expertise:** Successfully delivered 2 to 4 end\-to\-end S/4HANA greenfield/brownfield implementations or global rollouts, including international localization and multi\-gap tax/regulatory requirements.
* **Integration Track Record:** Hands\-on experience architecting FI integrations with SAP BRIM (Billing, Convergent Invoicing, FICA) and external subledgers/billing platforms.
* **Transformation Experience:** Direct architectural leadership in at least one full lifecycle RISE with SAP or S/4HANA Cloud deployment.
* **Technical Depth:** Expert\-level capability in analyzing custom ABAP code, debugging standard/custom SAP flows, designing complex APIs/interfaces, and structuring custom data models.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Deep familiarity with financial closing and reconciliation platforms such as BlackLine (ICH, Matching, Close Management) or OneStream.
* Strong understanding of modern reporting layers (SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP BTP, BI/BW, Snowflake).
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum product management methodologies in enterprise software tracks.
* Exposure to financial process automation, machine learning in cash application, or AI\-driven anomaly detection in financial close operations.

**Where You’ll Be**
-------------------


This role offers a flexible hybrid model.

**Join our digital revolution in NatWest Digital X**
----------------------------------------------------


In everything we do, we work to one aim. To make digital experiences which are effortless and secure.


So we organise ourselves around three principles: engineer, protect, and operate. We engineer simple solutions, we protect our customers, and we operate smarter.


**Job description**
-------------------


This role is based in India and as such all normal working days must be carried out in India.


Join us as a Scrum Master

  

  

* We’re looking for an experienced Scrum Master to drive a culture of continuous improvement
* You’ll make sure that your team lives by the values of Scrum, empowering them to become high performing to increase the productivity, as well as frequency and quality of delivery
* Hone your project skills as you work with talented people in collaborative and innovative environment, with access to the bank's Agile community, experts and events

------------------

  

  

This role will see you coaching and guiding your team to perform at their highest level and at a sustainable pace. You’ll remove any impediments to progress, facilitate meetings, protect the team from outside influences or distractions and work with the product owner to make sure that the product backlog is in good shape and ready for the next sprint.

  

  

Your responsibilities will include:

--------------------------

  

  

We're looking for someone with experience of successful Scrum adoption along with a Scrum Master certification. You'll need knowledge of modern development practices and tools, as well as a background in coaching cross\-functional teams into high performing teams.

  

  

You’ll also need knowledge of servant leadership, facilitation, situational awareness, conflict resolution, continual improvement, empowerment, and increasing transparency, as well as experience of building a culture of transparency within feature teams by empowering individuals and inspiring a collaborative team performance.

title: Global Product Cyber Security Expert – R&D Digital Portfolio EM&AO
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.



This Position reports to:



Digital Solution Engineering Manager \#\#\#


**Your role and responsibilities**



Working as a Global Digital Portfolio Cyber Security Expert, you will play a critical role in safeguarding our organization's digital assets for products of the global AUEN Digital Energy Management / Autonomous Operations products.



You will be responsible for **defining, governing and assuring cybersecurity\-by\-design across global R\&D product development**, ensuring compliance with ABB Product Security requirements, international standards (e.g. IEC 62443\), and applicable regulations.



The role acts as **global cybersecurity reference for the Digital Energy Management and Autonomous Operations product portfolio**, working with R\&D teams to embed security requirements into architectures, software, and lifecycle processes (SPDLC), while **challenging designs and approving security readiness**.



In this role, you will be part of a global team of product owners, software developers, architects, and testers to apply principles of software engineering, contribute to development as part of different state\-of\-the\-art cloud and edge software systems and architectures of the product portfolio.



You will be hosted in one of the team locations: Mannheim (DE), Genoa (IT), Bangalore (IN) in a hybrid mode (\#LI\-Hybrid)



Relocation of the candidate is not required.**\***



Your work will have a profound impact on the global cloud, cloud\-native and edge platform landscape.



You will be mainly accountable for:


**Cyber Security Management:**



Develop and implement comprehensive cyber security strategies, policies, and procedures to protect digital on\-prem/edge/cloud products against cyber threats, including malware, phishing, data breaches, and insider threats following the minimum cyber\-security requirements from ABB in full compliance, and responsibility, with PSA (Product Security Assessment) internal process.



Conduct regular security assessments and audits to identify vulnerabilities, risks and take proactive measures to address them.



Respond promptly to security incidents.



Implement access controls, encryption, and other security measures to safeguard sensitive data in line with Global Digital Team direction.


**Compliance and Risk Management:**



Stay up to date with industry Standards \& Compliance, regulations, and best practices related to cyber security and cloud computing, such as GDPR, NIS2, ISO/IEC 27001 and IEC 62443 SL3\.



Conduct risk assessments and develop mitigation strategies to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry standards.



Collaborate with internal teams and external auditors to ensure adherence to compliance requirements and address any findings, incidents or recommendations by executing and coordinating: investigation, schedule, corrective actions and disaster recovery plan to ensure business continuity.


**Other responsibilities/skills:**


* Collaborate with all organization members to contribute to the overall software development lifecycle in assigned areas and reach targets, share knowledge and contribute to a positive work atmosphere
* Follow agile software development practices to build and deliver software in an iterative and incremental manner as part of a global team’s scrum\-based development process
* Continue your personal learning journey by staying abreast of new and evolving software engineering technologies and sharing knowledge with team members
* A high level of self\-motivation, curiosity, as well as a strong desire and ability to learn and adapt to new technologies, tools, and programming languages
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot and debug software issues
* Project management capabilities
* Scrum and Agile methodologies knowledge
* Ensure that CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps practices incorporate cybersecurity controls and security testing requirements.


**Qualifications for the role**


* Master's degree in computer science with a focus on IT security. A PhD with cyber security focus is considered a plus.


Advanced degrees or certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CCSP) preferred.



10 years of proven experience in product or system cybersecurity for industrial or critical systems.



5 years in cloud computing, with a strong understanding of security principles, technologies, and best practices.



Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, including proficiency in cloud services and management tools. Familiarity with Azure DevOps for CI/CD pipelines.



Strong experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and Podman for container orchestration and management.



Proficiency in OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and identity management solutions such as Keycloak.



Experience with Helm charts for managing Kubernetes applications and deployments.



Strong understanding of the design and architecture of microservices, including principles such as loose coupling, bounded contexts, and domain\-driven design.



Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to effectively communicate technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders and work cross\-functionally with internal teams geographically distributed.



Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks in a fast\-paced environment, while also collaborating effectively as part of a global team.



Effective verbal and written communication skills in English, eventually German if location is Germany. Willing to travel, time to time, for office/site visit.



This opportunity is open to candidates in multiple countries, with the final work location determined based on the selected candidate. As compensation may vary by location, we are committed to being transparent throughout the hiring process and will share details of the salary range, variable compensation and benefits package with candidates who progress to the first interview stage for a location in the European Union, covered by the EU Pay Transparency Directive.\*


*The final offer will be tailored based on your role location, experience, skills and qualifications, internal market positioning and alignment with ABB internal standards.*

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.



Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

title: Senior Business Systems Analyst - Procurement - Bengaluru, Karnātaka, India
description:
### **About the Role**



Equinix is seeking a highly motivated **Senior Business Systems Analyst** to join our Bangalore office. In this role, you will serve as the functional and systems expert for Source to Pay processes and technology solutions, partnering closely with Procurement, Finance, Supply Chain, IT, and other business stakeholders to drive process excellence and digital transformation.



You will be responsible for analyzing business requirements, designing scalable P2P solutions, optimizing Source\-to\-Pay (S2P) processes, and supporting global procurement initiatives. The ideal candidate combines strong functional expertise in Oracle Fusion with exceptional analytical, stakeholder management, and solution design skills.



The successful candidate will play a key role in delivering business value through process standardization, automation, system enhancements, integrations, and adoption of best\-in\-class procurement practices that support Equinix's global operations.


### **Key Responsibilities**



 Serve as the primary functional SME for Oracle Financials and Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P) processes across global business units.



 Partner with Finance, Accounts Payable, Procurement, Supply Chain, Business Operations, and IT stakeholders to gather, analyze, document, and prioritize business requirements.



 Translate business requirements into functional designs, process improvements, solution architectures, and implementation roadmaps.



 Lead end\-to\-end Oracle Cloud/EBS functional initiatives spanning Procure\-to\-Pay, Accounts Payable, General Ledger integration points, Supplier Risk Management, Purchasing, and Financial Operations.



 Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on process optimization, automation, controls, compliance, and operational efficiency.



 Analyze current\-state business processes and identify opportunities for standardization, simplification, and digital transformation across finance and procurement functions.



 Facilitate requirements workshops, fit\-gap analyses, solution design sessions, process mapping exercises, and stakeholder reviews.



 Configure, support, and enhance Oracle Financials and Procurement modules, including system testing, deployment, and post\-production support.



 Collaborate with technical teams, integration teams, reporting teams, and third\-party vendors to deliver scalable enterprise solutions.



 Support and coordinate integrations between Oracle ERP and upstream/downstream systems, including banking, supplier, tax, reporting, and other enterprise applications.



 Lead data conversion, reconciliation, system validation, SIT/UAT testing, defect resolution, and change management activities during implementations and enhancements.



 Develop and maintain business process documentation, functional specifications, test scripts, training materials, and operational procedures.



 Design and support reports, dashboards, KPIs, and analytics that provide visibility into financial and operational performance.



 Partner with business leaders to recommend best\-practice solutions aligned with Oracle capabilities, governance standards, and evolving business needs.



 Troubleshoot complex production issues, perform root cause analysis, and drive timely resolution of functional and process\-related challenges.



 Support period\-end close activities, financial controls, audit requirements, and compliance initiatives related to P2P processes.



 Provide mentorship to junior analysts and consultants while contributing to functional competency development across Finance and ERP domains.



 Stay current with Oracle ERP capabilities, emerging technologies, industry trends, and best practices across Finance, P2P, and enterprise business processes.


### **Required Qualifications**



 Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Engineering, or a related field.



 8\+ years of experience as an Oracle Functional Consultant, Business Systems Analyst, ERP Analyst, or Functional Lead supporting Finance and Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P) business processes.



 Strong hands\-on experience with Oracle ERP Cloud and/or Oracle E\-Business Suite, including Purchasing, Accounts Payable, Supplier Management, General Ledger integrations, and Procurement modules.



 Deep understanding of end\-to\-end Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P), Accounts Payable (AP), Supplier Management, Financial Controls, and ERP business processes.



 Experience gathering business requirements and translating them into functional specifications, process designs, configuration solutions, and implementation roadmaps.



 Proven track record leading Oracle ERP implementations, upgrades, enhancements, and business transformation initiatives.



 Strong knowledge of finance and procurement controls, approval workflows, compliance requirements, audit support, and business governance practices.



 Experience supporting enterprise application integrations between Oracle ERP, Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, Banking, Tax, and third\-party systems.



 Hands\-on experience with configuration, testing, SIT/UAT coordination, defect management, production support, and release management activities.



 Strong understanding of Oracle reporting, analytics, dashboards, and KPI development to support business decision\-making.



 Experience with data conversion, data migration, reconciliation, and master data management activities.



 Strong analytical, problem\-solving, stakeholder management, and business process improvement skills.



 Experience working in Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, or hybrid project delivery environments.



 Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders across business and technology organizations.



 Ability to work effectively with global teams across multiple regions and time zones.



 Oracle Cloud certification in Procurement, Financials, or related Oracle ERP modules is preferred.



 Experience leading or supporting Oracle Cloud ERP implementation and transformation programs.



 Knowledge of complementary enterprise applications such as Coupa, SAP Ariba, Jaggaer, Ivalua, GEP, Concur, BlackLine, or other finance/procurement platforms is a plus.



 Experience with integrations, APIs, middleware platforms, and enterprise architecture frameworks.



 Strong understanding of Finance, Accounting, Supply Chain, and Shared Services business processes.



 Experience supporting month\-end close, financial operations, audit readiness, and compliance initiatives.



 Project management, change management, and stakeholder engagement experience preferred.

**Company Description** *Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.*

*The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and AgroScience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in\-vitro diagnostic products.*

*In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1,000 companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.*

*In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6\.95 billion; and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.*

 **Job Description** **Module Lead – Java**

**Eurofins IT Solutions, Bengaluru, Karnataka, India**  

  

With facilities in Europe, the United States, and Asia, Eurofins Genomics is an internationally leading provider of DNA sequencing services, genotyping services, DNA synthesis products, and bioinformatics services for pharmaceutical, diagnostics, food, agriculture, biotechnology, and research markets.  

  

The Genomics business is powered by global engineering teams building next\-generation applications, LIMS platforms, and enterprise systems. As a Tech Lead – Java, you will play a hands\-on leadership role in designing, developing, and modernizing scalable, high\-performance platforms.  

  

You will drive solution design, architecture decisions, and technical direction, while ensuring delivery excellence. The role requires close collaboration with engineering, architecture, DevOps, QA, and product teams to deliver robust, secure, and reliable solutions aligned with business goals.  

  

This role reports to a Project Manager / Senior Manager.  

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end\-to\-end technical design and development of enterprise\-scale Java applications
* Own solution architecture for modules/domains, ensuring scalability, performance, and reliability
* Drive modernization initiatives (monolith to microservices, cloud adoption)
* Define and enforce coding standards, design patterns, and best practices
* Review architecture, code, and design to ensure quality and maintainability
* Mentor and guide engineers, fostering strong technical capability within teams
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure seamless integration and delivery
* Act as the technical escalation point for complex issues and production challenges

**Required Skills**

* Strong hands\-on experience with:
* Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs
* Microservices and distributed system design
* Angular / React (working knowledge)
* SQL Server, MongoDBStrong understanding of design patterns, OOP, and scalable architectures
* Experience with performance tuning, JVM optimization, and system reliability
* Hands\-on experience with CI/CD, Docker, and cloud platforms
* Experience with event\-driven architectures and messaging systems
* Exposure to cloud\-native design and container orchestration (e.g., AKS/Kubernetes)
* Familiarity with DevOps practices, monitoring, and observability tools
* Experience in domain\-driven design or enterprise integration patterns

**Experience**

* 10–15 years of hands\-on experience in Java\-based development
* Proven experience as a Technical Lead in enterprise systems
* Strong experience in product development and modernization programs
* Solid understanding of Agile / Scrum methodologies

**Tech Stack**

* Frontend: Angular, React
* Backend: Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs
* Databases: SQL Server, MongoDB
* Cloud \& DevOps: Azure, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes (optional)
* Quality: JUnit, Mockito, SonarQube

**Additional Information**

**Required Qualifications:**  

Bachelors in Engineering or Masters in Computer Science or equivalent  

  

**Personal Skills:**

* Customer\-service oriented with a problem\-solving attitude;
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy is essential;
* Entrepreneurial thinking and flexibility to change;
* Very good English communication skills (concise writing and orally convincing);
* Structured and clear writing skills;
* Proven ability to solve complex business problems using analytical reasoning;
* Demonstrated positive attitude, self\-motivated, team player.


Additional Information

**Just some of the benefits we offer are:**

* Gym membership
* Company pension scheme
* + 24/7 Employee Assistance programme (Offering Legal, Financial, Medical advice and counselling), and many more

**The Location:**


Eurofins Digital Testing offices are based in Bristol City Centre. We are right next to Cabot Circus and many bars and restaurants. Our office is easy to commute to and has fantastic views over the city centre too. This area is a great place to live and work, with lots going on.

**Why Should You Apply?**

* Competitive pay with a well\-established and growing international company.
* Good benefits and flexible working opportunities.
* Great location within the city centre.
* Opportunities to progress and grow with the company.
* Occasional opportunities to travel and work around the UK and internationally.

**Start date: ASAP**


Interview process: Telephone interview followed by an online coding test and if selected, final stage is a face to face interview

 **Qualifications**  

* MCA or Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent.
* 8\+ years of hands\-on experience in Java\-based software development on global or enterprise projects.
* Proven experience in product development environments.
* Strong understanding of the Product Development Lifecycle and Lean Agile / Scrum methodologies.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Strong learning mindset and continuous improvement orientation.

title: Global Product Cyber Security Expert – R&D Digital Portfolio EM&AO
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.


This Position reports to:


Digital Solution Engineering Manager **Your role and responsibilities**

Working as a Global Digital Portfolio Cyber Security Expert, you will play a critical role in safeguarding our organization's digital assets for products of the global AUEN Digital Energy Management / Autonomous Operations products.


You will be responsible for **defining, governing and assuring cybersecurity\-by\-design across global R\&D product development**, ensuring compliance with ABB Product Security requirements, international standards (e.g. IEC 62443\), and applicable regulations.


The role acts as **global cybersecurity reference for the Digital Energy Management and Autonomous Operations product portfolio**, working with R\&D teams to embed security requirements into architectures, software, and lifecycle processes (SPDLC), while **challenging designs and approving security readiness**.


In this role, you will be part of a global team of product owners, software developers, architects, and testers to apply principles of software engineering, contribute to development as part of different state\-of\-the\-art cloud and edge software systems and architectures of the product portfolio.


You will be hosted in one of the team locations: Mannheim (DE), Genoa (IT), Bangalore (IN) in a hybrid mode (\#LI\-Hybrid)


Relocation of the candidate is not required.**\***


Your work will have a profound impact on the global cloud, cloud\-native and edge platform landscape.  

  

You will be mainly accountable for:

**Cyber Security Management:**


Develop and implement comprehensive cyber security strategies, policies, and procedures to protect digital on\-prem/edge/cloud products against cyber threats, including malware, phishing, data breaches, and insider threats following the minimum cyber\-security requirements from ABB in full compliance, and responsibility, with PSA (Product Security Assessment) internal process.


Conduct regular security assessments and audits to identify vulnerabilities, risks and take proactive measures to address them.


Respond promptly to security incidents.


Implement access controls, encryption, and other security measures to safeguard sensitive data in line with Global Digital Team direction.

**Compliance and Risk Management:**


Stay up to date with industry Standards \& Compliance, regulations, and best practices related to cyber security and cloud computing, such as GDPR, NIS2, ISO/IEC 27001 and IEC 62443 SL3\.


Conduct risk assessments and develop mitigation strategies to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry standards.


Collaborate with internal teams and external auditors to ensure adherence to compliance requirements and address any findings, incidents or recommendations by executing and coordinating: investigation, schedule, corrective actions and disaster recovery plan to ensure business continuity.

**Other responsibilities/skills:**

* Collaborate with all organization members to contribute to the overall software development lifecycle in assigned areas and reach targets, share knowledge and contribute to a positive work atmosphere
* Follow agile software development practices to build and deliver software in an iterative and incremental manner as part of a global team’s scrum\-based development process
* Continue your personal learning journey by staying abreast of new and evolving software engineering technologies and sharing knowledge with team members
* A high level of self\-motivation, curiosity, as well as a strong desire and ability to learn and adapt to new technologies, tools, and programming languages
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot and debug software issues
* Project management capabilities
* Scrum and Agile methodologies knowledge
* Ensure that CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps practices incorporate cybersecurity controls and security testing requirements.
**Qualifications for the role**

* Master's degree in computer science with a focus on IT security. A PhD with cyber security focus is considered a plus.


Advanced degrees or certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CCSP) preferred.


10 years of proven experience in product or system cybersecurity for industrial or critical systems.


5 years in cloud computing, with a strong understanding of security principles, technologies, and best practices.


Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, including proficiency in cloud services and management tools. Familiarity with Azure DevOps for CI/CD pipelines.


Strong experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and Podman for container orchestration and management.


Proficiency in OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and identity management solutions such as Keycloak.


Experience with Helm charts for managing Kubernetes applications and deployments.


Strong understanding of the design and architecture of microservices, including principles such as loose coupling, bounded contexts, and domain\-driven design.


Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to effectively communicate technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders and work cross\-functionally with internal teams geographically distributed.


Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks in a fast\-paced environment, while also collaborating effectively as part of a global team.


Effective verbal and written communication skills in English, eventually German if location is Germany. Willing to travel, time to time, for office/site visit.
* *This opportunity is open to candidates in multiple countries, with the final work location determined based on the selected candidate. As compensation may vary by location, we are committed to being transparent throughout the hiring process and will share details of the salary range, variable compensation and benefits package with candidates who progress to the first interview stage for a location in the European Union, covered by the EU Pay Transparency Directive.*

*The final offer will be tailored based on your role location, experience, skills and qualifications, internal market positioning and alignment with ABB internal standards.*

  

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.


Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

ABB never asks for payment from job applicants. All genuine job offers follow a formal application and interview process.

Agile Scrum Master Senior Analyst- Cigna Healthcare
description:
**Job Role:** Scrum Master/Agile Team Coach


About Cigna


Cigna is a global health insurance company, dedicated to its mission of helping improve the health, well\-being, and peace of mind of those we serve by making health care simple, affordable, and predictable.


Together with colleagues located across Europe, Asia Pacific, the Middle East, Africa, and India, you will support Cigna's International Health business. As part of Cigna Healthcare, International Health provides global and local health insurance solutions for internationally mobile individuals, multinational organizations, government entities, IGOs, NGOs, and local customers worldwide.


We are going through a global Agile transformation. As a result, we are expanding our teams and are looking for experienced Scrum Masters / Agile Team Coaches to join our team.

**Purpose of the Role**
=======================


The purpose of the Scrum Master / Agile Team Coach role is to maximize value delivery through collaboration, impediment removal, visibility, learning, and evidence\-based improvement.


This role supports high\-performing team dynamics, sustainable delivery, continuous flow, and self\-managed teams that are shaping and maturing Agile ways of working across International Health.

**About the Role**
==================


The Scrum Master / Agile Team Coach is a team coach and servant leader who facilitates change through the adoption and application of Agile principles, practices, and frameworks.


The role enables teams to self\-organize, improve flow, embrace effective ways of working, and consistently deliver value outcomes to stakeholders. The role partners closely with Product Owners, team members, Release Train Engineers, Agile Product Managers, and other stakeholders to support predictable delivery and continuous improvement.


This is a Band 3 Contributor Career Track Role.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Team Coaching and Agile Enablement**
--------------------------------------

* Provide coaching and guidance to Agile Teams and support the adoption and application of Agile values, principles, and practices.
* Act as a servant leader, facilitator, mentor, and coach for individuals and teams.
* Enable teams to improve collaboration, transparency, psychological safety, accountability, and self\-management.
* Use effective communication and listening skills to teach, coach, mentor, and support healthy team interactions.
* Foster a healthy working culture, build strong relationships, and strengthen key interactions across teams and stakeholders.

**Delivery Flow and Continuous Improvement**
--------------------------------------------

* Support teams in improving flow, reducing bottlenecks, managing impediments, and operating at a sustainable pace.
* Help teams establish realistic and achievable delivery commitments based on capacity, clarity, dependencies, and delivery risks.
* Maintain metrics and data necessary to provide visibility into maturity, progress, quality, flow, predictability, and value delivery.
* Facilitate evidence\-based improvement through retrospectives, improvement actions, and follow\-through on agreed outcomes.
* Encourage Built\-In Quality, continuous learning, and relentless improvement as part of day\-to\-day team working practices.

**Facilitation and Cadence Events**
-----------------------------------

* Support and facilitate team ceremonies and cadence events that drive progress toward value delivery and business outcomes.
* Facilitate team events such as planning, team syncs, backlog refinement, reviews, retrospectives, and improvement workshops, as applicable to the team context.
* Participate in Sync events, Scrum Master / Team Coach forums, and internal Agile communities of practice.
* Support ART\-level alignment events, including PI Planning, ART Sync, Coach Sync, System Demo, and Inspect \& Adapt, as applicable.

**ART Alignment, Dependencies, and Impediments**
------------------------------------------------

* Provide support that helps Agile Teams improve overall ART performance through collaboration and alignment between team objectives, vision, and strategic themes.
* Facilitate and support dependency management to ensure alignment of delivery across teams.
* Support removal of impediments that hinder achievement of team goals and objectives.
* Protect the team from unnecessary disruptions and external distractions while escalating systemic impediments in a timely manner.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, RTEs, Agile Product Managers, business stakeholders, and technology partners to maintain transparency and alignment.

**Success in this Role**
========================

* Teams demonstrate stronger self\-management, collaboration, and ownership of delivery outcomes.
* Impediments, blockers, dependencies, and delivery risks are made visible and addressed promptly.
* Team ceremonies and cadence events are purposeful, outcome\-focused, and continuously improved.
* Metrics and qualitative insights are used to improve flow, predictability, quality, and stakeholder transparency.
* Teams operate at a sustainable pace while maintaining alignment with ART priorities and International Health business outcomes.
* Continuous improvement becomes embedded in the team culture.

**Required Qualifications / Skills / Experience**
=================================================

* Certified Scrum Master (CSM), SAFe Scrum Master, SAFe Advanced Scrum Master, Professional Scrum Master, or equivalent Agile certification.
* At least 4 years of proven experience as a Scrum Master/Agile Team Coach role.
* Experience facilitating team development and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Strong knowledge of Lean\-Agile principles, Scrum practices, **Kanban practices**, and team\-level Agile delivery.
* Experience with Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) and understanding of its principles and practices.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, coaching, mentoring, and conflict resolution skills.
* Ability to work effectively with cross\-functional and geographically distributed teams.
* Strong problem\-solving, decision\-making, and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage priorities in a changing environment and support teams working under delivery deadlines.
* Ability to interact with Subject matter experts, Product Owners, Agile Product Managers, and stakeholders in a matrix structure.
* Knowledge of IT concepts, software delivery lifecycle, delivery methodologies, architecture considerations, and technical standards.

**Desired Qualifications / Skills / Experience**
================================================

* Working knowledge of Jira, Confluence, Mural, or similar collaboration tools.
* Experience supporting product, platform, operational, or service\-based delivery teams.
* Experience facilitating organizational change and Agile transformation initiatives.
* Experience in software development lifecycle, IT delivery, product delivery, or project management.

**About Cigna Healthcare**


Cigna Healthcare, a division of The Cigna Group, is an advocate for better health through every stage of life. We guide our customers through the health care system, empowering them with the information and insight they need to make the best choices for improving their health and vitality. Join us in driving growth and improving lives.*Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, age, disability, sex, childbirth (including pregnancy) or related medical conditions including but not limited to lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, religion, national origin, ancestry, marital or familial status, genetic information, status with regard to public assistance, citizenship status or any other characteristic protected by applicable equal employment opportunity laws.*

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**About us**


Camascope India is part of Person\-Centred Software (PCS) Group who are, a fast\-growing technology group focused on empowering the care and medication sector. Following PCS's acquisition of Camascope, our India team continues to build the products that connect pharmacies, care homes and doctors — now as part of a larger, international engineering organisation serving thousands of care professionals every day. This role is dedicated to a PCS product, working closely with our UK product engineering teams.

**What you will work on**


As Engineering Manager, you will build and lead a new team of 6 engineers in India delivering a PCS product, working closely with a counterpart engineering team in the UK. You will start hands\-on contributing directly to code for roughly half your time — while establishing team practices, hiring, and delivery rhythm. As the team matures and grows (including a planned second team under your leadership), your contribution will shift from hands\-on coding toward team leadership, coaching and cross\-team coordination.

**Responsibilities**

* Hire, build and lead a new engineering team of 6 in India, growing the team's capability and, over time, a second team under the same remit
* Contribute hands\-on to design, engineering and delivery of features — approximately 50% of your time initially, tapering as the team scales and matures
* Own day\-to\-day team operations — sprint delivery, 1:1s, performance management, hiring and career development
* Work closely with the UK product engineering team to align on delivery scope, priorities and technical direction for the shared PCS product
* Champion continuous delivery, with testing and security embedded in CI/CD pipelines, and promote DevSecOps practices across the team
* Make significant contributions to technical and architectural decisions, keeping systems, standards and practices coherent with the wider PCS engineering organisation
* Identify and remove blockers, process inefficiencies and technical debt proactively
* Be accountable for the full software development lifecycle — from design through to production, monitoring and support
* Foster a learning and mentoring culture; actively coach engineers and help them grow
* Collaborate closely with Product Managers, QA and Design to achieve shared product outcomes

**Requirements**

* 8\+ years of software engineering experience, including experience as an Engineering Manager or senior technical lead of a team, with a strong portfolio of C\#/.NET applications
* Deep understanding of the C\#/.NET ecosystem, and experience with cloud platforms (Azure and/or AWS) and cloud\-native development
* Experience with modern DevOps/CI\-CD practices
* Strong understanding of RESTful API design, security (e.g. OWASP API Security) and system architecture at scale
* Proven experience building and leading a team from the ground up — hiring, structuring, and establishing delivery practices for a new team
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience collaborating across distributed or international teams
* Capable and comfortable working with Agile/Scrum methodologies, and coaching a team on them
